source.layout_source: Red centerline extracted from Silverstone52-74.png, with the eight perimeter straights replaced by true straight chords and scaled to 4710 m.
source.coordinate_source: Approximate WGS84 coordinates from fixed-scale similarity alignment to the historic OHM 1948-1990 perimeter trace; OHM is used only as a coordinate scaffold, not as layout geometry.
source.elevation_note: Use this file for later elevation/terrain import because every cleaned image-layout point includes lat/lon and station_m.

straight_cleaning.assumption: The eight perimeter straights in the provided 1952 image are treated as straight; small chicane-like deviations from arrows/checker overlays are removed.

notes: Plan-view x/y geometry is the straight-cleaned image-derived 4710 m layout.
The lat/lon coordinates are approximate but station-aligned with the cleaned image layout for later elevation and terrain workflows.
The historic OHM trace and Evolution reference image were used only to correlate the old layout to present-day coordinates.

retained_inputs.note: Original layout coordinates retained. Heights and banking use the separate profiles and their declared station frames. Final XML includes subsequent edits.
